records.question: Which products are most popular?
records.raw:
SELECT p.product_id,
       COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, 'unknown') AS category,
       COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS units_sold
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN product_category_translation t
       ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
JOIN order_items oi
       ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders o
       ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY p.product_id, category
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 10;

records.question: Do orders delivered late receive lower review scores?

WITH delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id,
         CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date 
              THEN 'late' ELSE 'on_time' END AS delivery_status
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d.delivery_status,

FROM delivered_orders d
JOIN order_reviews r ON d.order_id = r.order_id
GROUP BY d.delivery_status;

records.question: What share of revenue comes from customers who ordered more than once?
records.raw:
WITH customer_rev AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
         SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) / SUM(revenue) AS share
FROM customer_rev;

records.question: What was the month-on-month revenue growth rate through 2017?
records.raw:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS month,
         SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2016-12-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month,
       revenue,
       (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS mom_growth_rate
FROM monthly_revenue
WHERE month >= DATE '2017-01-01'
ORDER BY month;

records.question: What share of total revenue do the ten largest sellers account for?
records.raw:
WITH seller_rev AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
total_rev AS (
  SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total FROM seller_rev
),
top10_rev AS (
  SELECT SUM(revenue) AS top10 FROM (
    SELECT revenue FROM seller_rev ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
  ) t
)
SELECT top10_rev.top10 / total_rev.total AS share
FROM top10_rev, total_rev;

records.question: In which month did the most customers place their first ever order?
records.raw:
```sql
WITH first_orders AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
         MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_order_ts
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', first_order_ts) AS month,
         COUNT(*) AS num_customers
  FROM first_orders
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT strftime(month, '%Y-%m') AS month
FROM monthly_counts
ORDER BY num_customers DESC, month
LIMIT 1;
```

records.question: What share of 2018 revenue came from Sao Paulo state?
records.raw:
WITH rev AS (
  SELECT oi.price, s.seller_state
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  LEFT JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN seller_state = 'SP' THEN price ELSE 0 END) / SUM(price) AS share_sp_revenue
FROM rev;
